Elyx runtime API

Access the runtime environment of a converted project.

Environment and modules

get_environment() looks up the current project environment. Use elyx.import_module(name) for dynamic module lookup and metainfo or refmap to inspect project metadata.

Java adapters

gen and gen2 adapt callbacks to Java interfaces. mvel_execute evaluates code through the host MVEL bridge. Run Android UI work on the UI thread.
